title: feat: add wine-dxmt runtime provider + third-party attributions for four upstream projects
body:
Adds first-class support for the [zzzz465/homebrew-wine-dxmt](https://github.com/zzzz465/homebrew-wine-dxmt) Homebrew tap and registers all four upstream Wine/DXMT projects in `THIRD_PARTY.md`.

## Runtime provider — `wine-dxmt`

- New `WineDxmtRuntimeProvider` (`src/runtimes/providers/wine-dxmt.ts`) targeting `/usr/local/bin/wine-dxmt` (the binary installed by `brew install --cask wine-dxmt`). Semantically identical to `WineRuntimeProvider`—sets `WINEPREFIX`, passes `WINEDEBUG=-all`, respects custom `runtimeExecutable`.
- `'wine-dxmt'` added to the `RuntimeKind` union.
- Provider registered in `registry.ts`; `WINE_DXMT_DEFAULT_PATH` exported from `lib/runtime-providers.ts`.

## Preset

New `src/presets/wine-dxmt-homebrew.json` — `"Wine + DXMT (Homebrew)"` preset with `renderer: dxmt`, registered in `COMPATIBILITY_PRESETS`.

## Third-party attributions (`THIRD_PARTY.md`)

Four projects added to the Compatibility layers section:

| Project | Role |
|---|---|
| [zzzz465/homebrew-wine-dxmt](https://github.com/zzzz465/homebrew-wine-dxmt) | Patched Wine Staging + DXMT Homebrew tap — new provider targets this |
| [3Shain/dxmt](https://github.com/3Shain/dxmt) | Metal-based DX11/10 translation layer; already used as `renderer: dxmt` |
| [Gcenx/game-porting-toolkit](https://github.com/Gcenx/game-porting-toolkit) | Community GPTK Wine builds; covered by existing `gptk` provider |
| [ByMedion/macos-wine-steam](https://github.com/ByMedion/macos-wine-steam) | Merlot one-click Wine + DXMT + Steam launcher; no separate provider needed |

## Tests

`runtime-providers.test.ts` updated: full `WineDxmtProvider` suite added, registry count assertion updated from 6 → 7.
